title: Binary encoding of a Boolean list
statement: For a finite list $w$ of Boolean values, map each entry to $1$ if it is true and $0$ if it is false, append a final digit $1$, and interpret the resulting list as base-$2$ digits; the resulting natural number is the binary encoding of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of Boolean values
